data_formats: Existing CSV/GeoJSON/PBF/document records
processing_workflow: Resolve Arabic/English aliases; corroborate identity; adopt locality version; preserve original wording and null geometry
eligibility: Verified identity and appropriate entrance/footprint required for location-dependent output
limitations: No fabricated GPS formal locality or fifteenth market

data_formats: Published tables/PDF/administrative CSV
update_frequency: Existing monitoring rounds; current-status review normally monthly
processing_workflow: Extract scoped open/partial/closed period and original source; adjudicate conflicts and staleness
eligibility: Applicable market-specific date and compatible definition; old/unknown remains missing
limitations: Intact roof or nearby lights do not establish trading

data_formats: Building vectors and licensed raster/product metadata
processing_workflow: Adopt baseline inventory; register adequate images; mark observable and unobservable structures
eligibility: Valid baseline/image scale and interpretation review
limitations: Medium-resolution pixels do not inspect stalls

data_formats: GeoJSON/GeoPackage damage units and raster pairs
processing_workflow: Count qualifying visible damage over observable baseline and publish coverage; independent desk review
eligibility: At least proposed 80 percent observable coverage for composite use and suitable imagery
limitations: No structural integrity internal damage or explosive-safety certification

data_formats: PBF/GeoJSON/GeoPackage and facility tables
update_frequency: Extract/release-specific; refresh after relevant inventory change
processing_workflow: Deduplicate sources and point/area institutions; summarize m2/ha and unique facility counts in declared area
eligibility: Valid inventory extent denominator and source coverage
limitations: Footprint does not measure vendors use or service operation

data_formats: Existing authorized CSV/PDF/service records
update_frequency: Existing service reports as issued; monthly review where feasible
processing_workflow: Record water sanitation/waste power-or-alternative and loading/storage status by period; retain unknown leaves
eligibility: Current applicable service evidence and predefined category adequacy
limitations: Mapped assets are not reliable affordable functioning services

data_formats: Facility tables reports and permitted vectors
processing_workflow: Extract capacity units observation period operation and technical prerequisites separately
eligibility: Documented facility identity capacity where actually supplied and status date
limitations: Roof area cannot prove cold chain or usable capacity

data_formats: Network edges/origins and OD Parquet/PostGIS tables
processing_workflow: Run unrestricted required origin-market paths; add reviewed connectors once; calculate weighted median among reachable origins
eligibility: Valid 5 km neighborhood denominator and no material unresolved origin/connector failure
limitations: Not observed journey safety fares or disability accessibility

data_formats: OD status tables and population origins
processing_workflow: Compute reachable population over all neighborhood population; separate disconnected from unresolved/failed paths
eligibility: Valid population and complete route-status accounting
limitations: Missing road data or skipped origins can mimic disconnection

data_formats: Population GeoTIFF plus conserved origin/assignment tables
update_frequency: Compatible provider release or material network/population change
processing_workflow: Select one baseline; reconcile totals; assign nearest eligible market within 60 minutes; count once and retain unallocated
eligibility: Defensible population basis and valid total-cost routing/candidate set
limitations: Not actual customers footfall or beneficiaries; projections are not current occupancy

data_formats: OD/cell tables and display MVT/GeoJSON
processing_workflow: Compute individual 15/30/60-minute origin reach and separate union; derive display envelopes
eligibility: Same mode scenario population release and verified entrances
limitations: Overlapping market catchments cannot be added as unique people

data_formats: Market-item CSV/XLSX/JSON and report tables
update_frequency: Typically monthly/source-specific with gaps and lag
processing_workflow: Harmonize grade unit retail/wholesale currency and dates; compute nominal matched changes; separate FX regimes
eligibility: Comparable positive prices and documented conversions
limitations: No inference of stock volume margin or purchasing power without evidence

data_formats: Explicit availability panel CSV/JSON/PDF
update_frequency: Monitor-round-specific; do not assume price cadence equals availability
processing_workflow: Predeclare eligible basket; available over observed items; publish observed over total
eligibility: Explicit observations and proposed 80 percent completeness for score
limitations: Missing prices are not stockouts; baskets differ by role

data_formats: Harmonized monthly price table
update_frequency: Monthly recomputation when comparable series exists
processing_workflow: Calculate standard deviation of monthly log changes for same item/market/unit
eligibility: Proposed 12 consecutive monthly prices producing 11 valid changes
limitations: Nominal inflation currency and seasonality confound interpretation

data_formats: Existing item/food-group availability records
processing_workflow: Map explicit eligible nutritious group presence and monitoring completeness within market type
eligibility: Applicable group definitions and availability evidence
limitations: Group presence is not food safety quantity nutrient intake or affordability

indicator_name: Reported origins hubs and supply links
data_formats: Report-derived nodes/links GeoJSON and tabular relations
update_frequency: Thematic/seasonal/report-specific; current flows require dated support
processing_workflow: Extract origin/hub/destination commodity season and source; map reported versus modelled separately
eligibility: Exact report reviewed and route/volume precision supported
limitations: No current tonnage or precise path from historic map or citation alone

data_formats: Network/scenario tables and actual route geometry
processing_workflow: Remove specified edges/crossings; compare travel cost and disconnection with reference
eligibility: Valid reference and disruption graphs with declared restrictions
limitations: Alternative path not observed passability or freight price

data_formats: Graph and path tables
processing_workflow: Compute edge-disjoint or defined alternatives on fixed topology and mode
eligibility: Document definition and shared crossing/corridor dependencies
limitations: Multiple paths are not independent suppliers or independent hazards

data_formats: Authorized event CSV/API and precision audit
update_frequency: Provider rolling/weekly revisions where authorized; source-specific lag
processing_workflow: Deduplicate eligible violence events; review precision; recency-weight 5 km/180 days with declared alternatives
eligibility: Access coverage location/date precision suitable for intended support
limitations: Zero qualifying records does not establish safety; datasets not simply summed

data_formats: Existing access reports and authorized records
processing_workflow: Extract scoped market/corridor closure or restriction claims and original lineage
eligibility: Actual date/geography and sensitivity appropriate
limitations: Do not expose sensitive live detail or duplicate one event through reposts

indicator_name: Flood exposure of markets roads and residents
data_formats: Native depth GeoTIFF masks observed extents and exposure tables
update_frequency: Irregular hazard versions plus dated events/scenario reruns
processing_workflow: Use raw depth and masks; fractional native-support overlay; publish valid/unknown coverage; separate event/hazard
eligibility: Correct global resource unit grid and denominator
limitations: No local drainage approval monetary loss or nodata-as-dry

data_formats: Consistent-version rainfall GeoTIFF/NetCDF
update_frequency: Product preliminary/final cadence; v3 final typically monthly
processing_workflow: Choose coherent version; rebuild 1991-2020 climatology and comparable current series; local/upstream basin summaries
eligibility: No untested v2/v3 concatenation and no near-zero baseline percent artifact
limitations: 0.05 degree not plot drainage; local rain alone not Nile flooding

indicator_name: Surface heat and regional thermal context
data_formats: Landsat temperature raster and ERA5-Land arrays
update_frequency: Scene-specific clear-sky temperature; regional reanalysis daily update/hourly support
processing_workflow: Apply exact product QA and scale/offset; retain acquisition time; separate surface/air temperature
eligibility: Valid units masks native thermal support and time
limitations: Not occupational WBGT or market measured air temperature

data_formats: Surface reflectance GeoTIFF and land/producer-area vectors
processing_workflow: Quality-mask reflectance; NDVI with valid denominator; interpret phenology in supported supply areas
eligibility: Comparable seasons bands and documented relevant geography
limitations: Not crop yield trader income market function or household food security

data_formats: Historical surface-water raster plus existing service records
update_frequency: Product-version and actual service-record cadence differ
processing_workflow: Keep occurrence/seasonality separate from dated operational WASH evidence
eligibility: Valid product support and explicit service evidence for operation
limitations: Surface water is not potable supply groundwater or operating water point

data_formats: Quality-controlled VIIRS arrays/COG and summaries
update_frequency: Selected daily/monthly product cadence and platform continuity
processing_workflow: Same collection/platform or tested harmonization; QA observed/gap-filled values; matched months and noise-floor check
eligibility: Enough valid observations/area for chosen product and meaningful neighborhood support
expected_confidence: Conditional medium neighborhood; low individual-market attribution
limitations: No GDP sales jobs footfall or causal conversion

data_formats: PBF/GeoJSON/facility tables
processing_workflow: Classify/deduplicate mapped institutions and distinguish dated operating evidence
eligibility: Known inventory completeness/support and no point-area double count
limitations: Informal traders underrepresented; OSM edits are not new firms

data_formats: Existing reports and role records
processing_workflow: Extract geographic reach and role with actual date; review historical/current relevance
eligibility: Positive applicable evidence for hierarchy rubric
limitations: Specialization size or radiance alone not regional economic importance

data_formats: Fixed graph and centrality table
processing_workflow: Use vetted NetworkX or equivalent; fix directedness components endpoint normalization and node matching
eligibility: Graph and 0.10 provisional anchor approved before ranks
limitations: Potential network position not observed trade; extent-sensitive

data_formats: Existing provider/regulator lists terms and studies
processing_workflow: Separate mapped presence operation products rates liquidity and applicable participation barriers
eligibility: Exact relevant documents and periods; no proximity-to-uptake inference
limitations: No proof of borrowing affordable credit insurance or equal access from a branch point

data_formats: Coverage vector/grid sampled-test tables existing outage records
update_frequency: Operator/product/quarter/report-specific; not a live universal feed
processing_workflow: Separate coverage sampled performance outages payments and actual adoption evidence
eligibility: Permitted source sufficient tested samples and documented scope
limitations: Coverage/speed not affordability reliability adoption or women's access

indicator_name: Women youth and disability inclusion evidence
data_formats: Existing study/admin tables and qualitative reports
processing_workflow: Retain age/disability definitions sample frame denominator period and scope; summarize safely
eligibility: Applicable disaggregation or scoped qualitative findings
limitations: No trader demographics from resident age/sex or mapped buildings

data_formats: Existing authorized permissions/parcel/consent records
processing_workflow: Review existing applicable lawful pathway disputes and permissions against approved rubric
eligibility: Qualified valid records; absent evidence remains unknown
limitations: Vacant appearance not ownership consent or dispute-free site

data_formats: Existing qualified reports designs and cost records
processing_workflow: Check scope authority date options and cost preparation; do not substitute remote appearance for qualified review
eligibility: Relevant existing specialist evidence with limitations
limitations: Not tender-ready quantities or structural clearance from roof imagery

data_formats: Existing agreements budgets fee/service plans
processing_workflow: Verify responsible owner duties plausible operating costs and actual funding evidence
eligibility: Viable documented arrangements not merely named owner
limitations: No maintenance revenue from population size or assumed market growth

data_formats: Hazard/context products and existing screening/permission records
processing_workflow: Combine scoped flood/drainage/waste/fire/inclusion/displacement and mitigation preparation evidence
eligibility: Actual permissions/specialist requirements remain independent
expected_confidence: Conditional medium screening; lower without records
limitations: Hazard overlap not permit consultation consent or completed mitigation

data_formats: Repeated existing status/service observations and qualified imagery
update_frequency: Repeated eligible observations; no fixed daily completeness
processing_workflow: Compare matched periods and bracket last disrupted/first recovered; keep signal supports distinct
eligibility: More than one relevant observation and appropriate comparability
limitations: Single image cannot show recovery duration or attributable livelihood impact

data_formats: Existing commodity-origin/supplier reports
processing_workflow: Count distinct positively documented contemporary source categories with definitions
eligibility: Source evidence and date sufficient; unknown counts retained
limitations: Road alternatives not independent suppliers; citation alone no counts

data_formats: Matched basket-price and wage/income/transfer tables
update_frequency: Comparable source periods; monthly only where both exist
processing_workflow: Match numerator/denominator units group period and currency; specify basket-cost/wage or wage-to-commodity construct
eligibility: Applicable purchasing-power denominator; otherwise price context only
limitations: One wage/transfer quote does not represent every household

indicator_name: Trader employment capital and participation records
data_formats: Existing authorized study/admin aggregates and reports
processing_workflow: Separate traders stalls permits job-days unique workers and capital definitions; remove personal details
eligibility: Valid scope dates sample/registry coverage and denominators
limitations: No trader/job/profit/capital estimate from lights roofs or residents

indicator_name: Food quality protection and safe-access evidence
data_formats: Existing qualified inspection/protection/clearance reports
processing_workflow: Keep food quality protection and safety subjects separately scoped; minimize sensitivity and preserve unknowns
eligibility: Actual relevant specialist records; no remote certification
limitations: No inference of hygiene safe access consent or absence of exploitation from proxies

data_formats: Existing role descriptions and documented function records
processing_workflow: Code retail wholesale aggregation and onward-distribution supported presence/absence; unknown as missing leaf
eligibility: Four role definitions frozen and evidence-specific
